messages:
marie: Pushed updated mock for the Alerting SLO editor — focusing on 'signal fidelity' indicator and channel mapping in the preview. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/alerts-ui?v=3 :eyes:

marie: Key changes: 1) per-threshold mini chart showing recent signal vs threshold, 2) preview shows which channels will fire with priority badges, 3) suppression toggle moved inline to each channel

tim: Quick q — when a suppression window overlaps multiple channels, which channel gets the 'muted' badge? we should avoid ambiguity

marie: Good point. Proposal: badge shows per-channel status in preview; if a global suppression applies show a banner at top "Global suppression active" and individual channels get muted state too

kevin: A11y nit: badges need accessible labels and focus order. If we keep inline toggles they must be operable via keyboard and screen reader announces "Channel X notifications muted"

sophie: Copy tweak suggestion: replace "Preview" header with "Who will be notified" — clearer for non-product folks. Also rename "signal fidelity" tooltip to "Signal match rate"

marie: Love both. Also added a tiny sparkline under each threshold row. Thoughts on color contrast? current orange is borderline on dark mode

kevin: Contrast concern for orange + gray background. Use #B45309 for orange variant; add focus ring on badge

tim: UX question: how expensive is it to compute per-threshold sparkline on the fly? backend costs? might need sampling or caching

marie: Backend can return last 1h decimated series; client renders tiny canvas. I'll add a cache hint to the API. Example payload snippet:
```
{ "threshold_id": "t-123", "sparkline": "base64png", "channels": ["pagerduty","email"] }
```

sophie: Also pinging the support folks — will this change how previews are logged? need to keep audit trail for who toggled suppressions

marie: Yes. Will emit events for suppression changes. Adding 'who' and 'why' fields in the audit entry

deploy-bot: screenshot uploaded: designs/alerts/signal-fidelity-v3.png

tim: OK, next steps: marie to update figma with copy and contrast, kevin to write a11y checklist, I’ll sync w/ backend on sparkline cache. Let's review again Wed 10am PST :calendar:

marie: Thanks all — updated figma and PR coming shortly :sparkles:
